title.suggested: Hartgrove Says Barrington's Silk Hat Was Tom Allen's

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tillie Hartgrove claimed the silk hat worn by "Lord" Barrington belonged to Tom Allen's estate; saloon keeper J. W. Gillespie said he had loaned it to him.

facts.fact: Hartgrove, Allen's housekeeper, claimed the silk hat worn by "Lord" Barrington, then held at the Clayton jail, was the property of the Allen estate; J. W. Gillespie said he had loaned Barrington the hat
